# lub/docs/tech-report/artifacts/ — Generated Evaluation Artifacts

**Purpose:** machine-generated outputs from `lub benchmark` + `lub report` runs — used as figures, tables, and OSCAL/AI-RMF exhibits in the tech report and petition evidence. These files are the **outputs** of the library, not inputs to it.

**Generation:** regenerated by running `lub benchmark … && lub report …` at the repo root. Do NOT hand-edit — edits get overwritten on the next run. If a number is wrong, fix the estimator or fix the dataset; don't fix the artifact.

**Related:**
- **Canonical facts** → `planning/CANONICAL_FACTS.md` (repo tree). Numbers in `results_table*.md` must match what CANONICAL_FACTS declares for the relevant model variant.
- **Tech-report LaTeX** → [`../`](../) — the tech-report build imports PNGs and JSON tables from here.
- **OSCAL spec** → NIST SP 800-53 / AI-RMF crosswalk that the `oscal_*` files serialize to.

---

## Three variants — which is canonical?

Files in this folder come in three parallel variants, distinguishable by filename suffix:

| Suffix | Backend / Model | Purpose | Canonical for what? |
|---|---|---|---|
| *(no suffix)* e.g. `result_token_logprob.json`, `airmf_report.md`, `results_table.md` | **DummyBackend** — deterministic stub | Smoke tests, CI runs, hermetic examples | Unit-test fixtures + tutorial-doc screenshots only. **Not** a citable result. |
| `_real` e.g. `result_real_token_logprob.json`, `airmf_report_real.md`, `results_table_real.md` | **distilgpt2** — small real model (HuggingFace) | End-to-end reality check on a real-but-tiny model | Tech-report §Results (baseline run). The "real but tiny" numbers. |
| `_qwen` e.g. `result_qwen_token_logprob.json`, `results_table_qwen.md` | **Qwen2.5-0.5B** (HuggingFace) | Larger realistic run | Tech-report §Results (headline numbers) + arXiv abstract §5. Canonical for citable quantitative claims. |

**Abstract / petition rule of thumb:** if you're quoting numbers to USCIS, arXiv, or a recommender, cite the `_qwen` variant. If you're citing the DummyBackend variant you are misrepresenting the library.

Note: `18g_Abstract_Draft_2026-04-22.md` flags Section-5 numbers as PLACEHOLDER pending real Qwen2.5-0.5B runs — verify the `_qwen` numbers here are final before arXiv submission.

---

## File categories

| Category | Pattern | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| Per-estimator results | `result_[real_|qwen_]<estimator>.json` | One JSON record per (estimator × backend) run. Signed via `lub.benchmarks` runner. |
| Reliability diagrams | `reliability_[real_|qwen_]<estimator>.png` | Calibration plot — confidence vs. accuracy buckets. |
| Histograms | `histogram_[real_|qwen_]<estimator>.png` | Confidence distribution across the eval set. |
| Risk-coverage curves | `risk_coverage_[real_|qwen_]<estimator>.png` | PRR / AURC visual — selective-prediction quality. |
| Results summary tables | `results_table[_real\|_qwen].md` | One-line-per-estimator metrics table (Accuracy, ECE, AUROC, PRR, Brier, RMSCE). |
| AI RMF report | `airmf_report[_real].{md,html}` | Jinja2-rendered AI RMF report (Govern/Map/Measure/Manage). |
| OSCAL exhibits | `oscal_component_definition.json`, `oscal_assessment_results.json`, `oscal_cd_real.json`, `oscal_ar_real.json`, `oscal_assessment_nist_genai.json` | Machine-readable NIST OSCAL component-definition + assessment-results exports. |

**Deprecated / historical:** `airmf_report.md` + `airmf_report.html` (DummyBackend variant) are retained for reproducibility of early-April screenshots but should NOT be cited. Use `airmf_report_real.*` for tech-report references.

---

## Regeneration

```bash
# From repo root
lub benchmark --estimator token_logprob --backend dummy --out docs/tech-report/artifacts/
lub benchmark --estimator token_logprob --backend hf --model distilgpt2 --out docs/tech-report/artifacts/ --suffix _real
lub benchmark --estimator token_logprob --backend hf --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B --out docs/tech-report/artifacts/ --suffix _qwen
# Repeat for perplexity, self_consistency, p_true, token_sar …
lub report --format airmf --out docs/tech-report/artifacts/airmf_report_real.md
```

Full regeneration takes ~20 min on a modern laptop (Dummy + distilgpt2) plus several hours for the Qwen2.5-0.5B pass on GPU-less hardware. Cache the Qwen model locally to avoid re-downloads.

---

## House rules

- **Do not hand-edit.** Fix the source (estimator / dataset / runner) and regenerate.
- **Regenerate all three variants together** when possible — mismatched variants create confusing results tables.
- **Commit regenerations as one commit** with a message like `regen artifacts: distilgpt2 + Qwen2.5-0.5B sweep`. Do not spread across many commits.
- **Freeze a copy** in `_archive/YYYY-MM-DD/artifacts/` before any tech-report or arXiv submission — the submission exhibit must be stable even if HEAD artifacts drift.
